verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments platform, so in-product AI-generated insights on merchant data is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents such a feature. The docs cover card payments, refunds, 3DS, POS and payment links. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes only show AI-readable documentation, which is an adjacent feature, not in-product insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
